claims.text: On AI: bisphosphonates and denosumab prevent bone loss; denosumab ↓fractures in postmenopausal women
claims.quote: Both bisphosphonates and denosumab prevent bone loss; additionally, denosumab has proven anti-fracture benefit in post-menopausal women receiving aromatase inhibitors for hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
claims.locator: Assessment and management of bone health in women with oestrogen receptor-positive breast cancer receiving endocrine therapy: position statement summary. Med J Aust. 2019;211(5):224-229 (abstract, PubMed)
